_comment: English body for canva-magic-studio; generated from the Chinese dossier and official pages, not a literal translation.

axes.model_access: Driven by Canva’s generative design capabilities together with third-party models; the specific models are not disclosed item by item, and available features vary by tier and region.
axes.runtime: Runs in Canva’s cloud; web, desktop and mobile are all entry points, and generation and rendering happen server-side.
axes.local_files: Can upload images, fonts, brand assets and documents; local files must be uploaded and cannot be scanned directly from the local disk.
axes.background: Design generation and bulk adjustments happen within a session; there are no background jobs that survive shutdown. Tasks are triggered per request and no resident agent remains; long work must be split into reviewable steps.
axes.tools: Integrated with the Canva editor, Brand Kit, template library, Magic Write / Magic Design and image editing; exports in multiple formats.
axes.context: Context is mainly the current design, Brand Kit and uploaded assets; cross-project memory is limited. Cross-document and cross-session memory is limited, so complex work needs manual context and source citations.
axes.permissions: Commercial licensing depends on the Canva tier and the asset source; the copyright boundary between AI-generated and user-uploaded images must be checked separately.
axes.fit: Fits: social images, presentations, posters and lightweight brand material. Does not fit: professional design workflows that need pixel-level print control or complex vector editing.
